steps.text: The operation page shows its name, type, meters and covered municipalities. The pencils let you edit this information.
steps.title: Operation detail

steps.text: Click "Edit" in the header — the form opens, pre-filled with the operation's current details.
steps.title: Open the edit form

steps.text: Change the operation's name. You can also adjust its type and municipalities here.
steps.title: Rename the operation

steps.text: Back on the page, the operation carries its new name.
steps.title: Name updated

steps.text: The pencil next to the municipalities opens the editor for the operation's covered municipalities.
steps.title: Edit the municipalities

steps.text: Type a municipality and pick it from the suggestions to add it to the operation's scope.
steps.title: Add a municipality

steps.text: The municipality "Ixelles" now appears among the operation's covered municipalities.
steps.title: Municipality added
